name: Eden
source:
Marisol has been a bartender at Eden for many years. Lately, customers have been coming in right before closing with oddities she can’t make sense of. Make drinks while you discern the truth.

[From [url=https://apineappleperson.itch.io/eden]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Marisol在Eden担任调酒师多年。最近，顾客在关门前进来，带来一些她无法理解的奇怪现象。当你辨别真相时，准备饮料。

[来自[url=https://apineappleperson.itch.io/eden]Itch.io[/url]]
